The one-shot in-memory index for the billion-point datasets was built on the **M64-32ms** machine (page 8). It is a virtual machine with dual Xeon E7-8890v3 processors (32 vCPUs) and **1792GB of DDR3 RAM** (page 8).

For the SIFT1B bigann dataset, building the one-shot index on M64-32ms took about 2 days. Peak memory use was about 1100GB (page 8).
